notes.title: RUM 0.2.1
notes.content:
This is a smaller update but just wanted to let everyone know that more updates are coming. Currently I added support for most of the bandit camp trades, all the fishing village trades, and a horse dung/fertilizer calculator underneath the resources tab.

Thanks again for purchasing RUM!

notes.title: How to discuss and suggest features for RUM
notes.content:
Hey everyone, a handful of you have already bought the tool and I appreciate it so much. I just wanted to let everyone know for giving ideas about new features the best way is to create a discussion underneath the community group or to click Discuss underneath this post. I'm open minded to any and all features you may have and will work to add them to the tool as quickly as possible.

Thanks!
- Alex
